'''Cannon''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who was raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point during the conflict, Cannon accompanied the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[B'ink Utrila]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Rennax Omani]] and fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] [[Law]], [[Horns]] and [[Glitch]] on a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draay 2]], to find the ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] the [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]] and prevent it from falling into the hands of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The party tracked down the [[Jedi Temple (Draay 2)|Jedi Temple]] in which the artifact was housed, but they were attacked there by a band of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], who sought to seize the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] relic for themselves.<ref name="Defenders of TLT" />
